title: 경계선은 지나고 나서 보인다
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and J-Rock fusion. Distorted electric guitars play syncopated power chords and palm-muted eighth notes. A bright, clean electric guitar performs staccato rhythmic stabs. The bass guitar follows the kick drum with a driving, overdriven tone. Drums feature a high-tuned snare and consistent crash cymbal hits on the downbeats. Male vocals are delivered with a bright, energetic pop-rock timbre. The tempo is 165 BPM in the key of E Major. Production includes rapid vocal layering and a clean, compressed mix typical of modern idol rock.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, driving drums, bass guitar]

[Verse 1]
[bright male vocals]
이른 아침이야 알람보다 먼저 눈 떴어 [palm-muted guitar]
오늘은 월급날이야 한 달을 버텼어
출근 지하철에서 [snare hit] 헤이! [shouted ad-lib]
은행 앱 열었어 [snare hit] 헤이! [shouted ad-lib]
아직 입금 전이야 새로고침 새로고침 9시 1분 입금
숫자가 올라갔어 잠깐만 기뻐하자

[Chorus]
[full band intensity increases]

잔고가 월초랑 똑같아
